_about: Himalayan evaluation scenes for the flood model (O-005). Water labels come from clear-sky Sentinel-2 L2A taken close to the Sentinel-1 post image; never from Copernicus EMS or other published maps. S1 pairs are pre/post from the same relative orbit (track). Dates from the Planetary Computer STAC catalogue (copy of Copernicus Sentinel data). Labels are kept only below label_max_elev_m (snow zone excluded) and on slopes <= 20 degrees.

events.note: Rishiganga/Dhauliganga glacier-rock avalanche and debris flood, Uttarakhand, India, 7 Feb 2021. Winter, clear sky; deep gorges with radar shadow.
South Lhonak lake outburst flood down the Teesta, Sikkim, India, 4 Oct 2023. Mountain section Chungthang - Teesta Bazar.
Marsyangdi valley (Besisahar), Nepal, dry season, no flood: every predicted flood pixel is a false alarm. Measures radar-shadow false positives in steep terrain.
